fusions.name: Drag Furrow
fusions.desc: Drags a claw through every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Its damage rises +10% per affliction on each target (max +50%). You have 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Last Furrow
fusions.desc: A finishing drag that deals 22 damage, then consumes every affliction on the target for 60% more damage each. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Scraped Together
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, with a 12% chance to critically heal. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Gleaned Spoils
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
